s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin condition with painful nodules and ulceration in the groin area, with a history of intertrigo and recent development of bright red, burning nodules
salient_findings: Bright red, burning and painful nodules around the scrotum
Epidermal ulceration overlying a diffuse dermal proliferation composed of sheets of histiocytes with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies present as basophilic, somewhat laminated intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies
key_facts: 3-month history of intertrigo involving the groin
Treated with clotrimazole cream, 1%, and hydrocortisone cream, 1%
Condition improved, then developed bright red, burning and painful nodules
Medical history includes prostate cancer, hypertension, anxiety disorder, hyperlipidemia, gastroesophageal reflux disease, and diverticulosis
Current medications include omeprazole, alprazolam, amlodipine besylate, atenolol, simvastatin, and valsartan
Two symmetrical solitary erythematous nodules present in the right and left inguinal folds
Histopathological examination showed epidermal ulceration and diffuse dermal proliferation
Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies were present
Bacterial culture was positive for E. coli
Fungus culture and atypical mycobacteria culture were negative

shortlist.label: Malakoplakia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies in histopathological examination

shortlist.label: Granuloma inguinale
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic skin condition with painful nodules and ulceration in the groin area

shortlist.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
shortlist.why_kept: History of intertrigo and development of bright red, burning nodules

shortlist.label: Erythema nodosum
shortlist.why_kept: Symmetrical solitary erythematous nodules present in the inguinal folds

shortlist.label: Cutaneous tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse dermal proliferation and presence of histiocytes with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm

raw.rationale: The presence of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies in the histopathological examination is a hallmark of Malakoplakia, which is a rare inflammatory condition often associated with bacterial infections, such as E. coli, as seen in the positive bacterial culture.

rejected.label: Granuloma inguinale
rejected.why: Lack of evidence for Donovan bodies, which are characteristic of Granuloma inguinale.

rejected.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not align with the typical features of Hidradenitis suppurativa, such as comedonal lesions and sinus tracts.

rejected.label: Erythema nodosum
rejected.why: The presence of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies and the specific bacterial culture results are not consistent with Erythema nodosum, which typically presents with septal panniculitis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous tuberculosis
rejected.why: The histopathological findings and bacterial culture results do not support a diagnosis of Cutaneous tuberculosis, which would typically show caseating granulomas and a positive culture for Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
